name: Ciphertel
summary: WA licensed carrier and ISP (fixed wireless, microwave and fibre) serving regional Western Australia; Perth-origin, later based in Bunbury; still active.

events.details: Perth communications company (SMS/GSM products) from 2002; later a licensed WA carrier ISP.

Holds the former Bunbury Internet Service /21 (203.18.248.0-203.18.255.255, the 1997 BUNBURYINT-AU block): APNIC whois netname CIPHERTEL-NON-AU, Unit 3/9 Bourke Street, Bunbury WA 6230, network object registered 4 Sep 2008. UNCERTAIN whether this was an acquisition of Bunbury Internet Service or a pivot of the same business under the Ciphertel name; the block transfer is the documented evidence.
